entities.name: Anawrahta and Burmese Unification
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The founding and early growth of Pagan, King Anawrahta's unification of the Irrawaddy valley, the conquest of Thaton, the adoption of Theravada Buddhism as state religion, and the beginning of massive temple construction.
